model_details.name: RAHAT Landslide Hazard Nowcast Candidate Engine
model_details.algorithm: Gradient Boosted Decision Trees & Rule-Based Fallback

intended_use.primary_purpose: Decision-support estimation of relative landslide hazard levels for Northeast India terrain zones.
excluded_uses: Do not use as a sole trigger for automated mass evacuations.
Do not claim guaranteed prediction of exact landslide occurrence times or locations.
Do not issue unverified public emergency broadcasts.

data_provenance.terrain_metadata: GSI Regional Vulnerability & LiDAR Topographic Surveys

known_failure_modes: Rapid flash floods without prior antecedent rainfall logging
Unmonitored seismic triggering without real-time accelerometers
Stale or degraded weather provider API connectivity
uncertainty_and_limitations.disclaimer: This candidate model provides relative risk decision support. Requires Admin approval before operational status.
